import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def to_float(x):
    return float(x) if pd.notna(x) else None

def main():
    path = sys.argv[1]
    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    facts = []

    # ---- Totals ----
    total_rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_units_tw = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_units_lw = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"TW",
                  "value":round(float(total_rev_tw),2),
                  "formula":"sum(Revenue_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LW",
                  "value":round(float(total_rev_lw),2),
                  "formula":"sum(Revenue_LW)"})
    if pd.notna(total_rev_ly) and total_rev_ly != 0:
        facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LY",
                      "value":round(float(total_rev_ly),2),
                      "formula":"sum(Revenue_LY)"})

    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"TW",
                  "value":round(float(total_units_tw),2),
                  "formula":"sum(Units_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"TW",
                  "value":round(float(total_orders_tw),2),
                  "formula":"sum(Orders_TW)"})

    if total_rev_lw and total_rev_lw != 0:
        wow = (total_rev_tw - total_rev_lw) / total_rev_lw * 100
        facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"WoW",
                      "value":round(float(wow),1),
                      "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW)-sum(Revenue_LW))/sum(Revenue_LW)*100"})

    if total_rev_ly and pd.notna(total_rev_ly) and total_rev_ly != 0:
        yoy = (total_rev_tw - total_rev_ly) / total_rev_ly * 100
        facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"YoY",
                      "value":round(float(yoy),1),
                      "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW)-sum(Revenue_LY))/sum(Revenue_LY)*100"})

    if total_units_lw and total_units_lw != 0:
        wow_u = (total_units_tw - total_units_lw) / total_units_lw * 100
        facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"WoW",
                      "value":round(float(wow_u),1),
                      "formula":"(sum(Units_TW)-sum(Units_LW))/sum(Units_LW)*100"})

    if total_orders_lw and total_orders_lw != 0:
        wow_o = (total_orders_tw - total_orders_lw) / total_orders_lw * 100
        facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"WoW",
                      "value":round(float(wow_o),1),
                      "formula":"(sum(Orders_TW)-sum(Orders_LW))/sum(Orders_LW)*100"})

    # ---- Top entities by Revenue_TW ----
    top_df = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, row in top_df.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"TW",
                      "value":round(float(row['Revenue_TW']),2),
                      "formula":"Revenue_TW"})
        if pd.notna(row.get('Share_Pct')):
            facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"share","period":"TW",
                          "value":round(float(row['Share_Pct']),1),
                          "formula":"Share_Pct"})
        if pd.notna(row.get('Rank')):
            facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"rank","period":"TW",
                          "value":float(row['Rank']),
                          "formula":"Rank"})

    # ---- WoW movers ----
    wow_df = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW','Revenue_LW'])
    wow_df = wow_df[wow_df['Revenue_LW'] != 0].copy()
    wow_df['WoW_calc'] = (wow_df['Revenue_TW'] - wow_df['Revenue_LW']) / wow_df['Revenue_LW'] * 100

    top_gain = wow_df.sort_values('WoW_calc', ascending=False).head(3)
    for _, row in top_gain.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"WoW",
                      "value":round(float(row['WoW_calc']),1),
                      "formula":"(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LW)/Revenue_LW*100"})

    top_lose = wow_df.sort_values('WoW_calc', ascending=True).head(3)
    for _, row in top_lose.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"WoW",
                      "value":round(float(row['WoW_calc']),1),
                      "formula":"(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LW)/Revenue_LW*100"})

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    yoy_df = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW','Revenue_LY'])
    yoy_df = yoy_df[yoy_df['Revenue_LY'] != 0].copy()
    yoy_df['YoY_calc'] = (yoy_df['Revenue_TW'] - yoy_df['Revenue_LY']) / yoy_df['Revenue_LY'] * 100

    if not yoy_df.empty:
        top_gain_y = yoy_df.sort_values('YoY_calc', ascending=False).head(2)
        for _, row in top_gain_y.iterrows():
            facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"YoY",
                          "value":round(float(row['YoY_calc']),1),
                          "formula":"(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LY)/Revenue_LY*100"})

        top_lose_y = yoy_df.sort_values('YoY_calc', ascending=True).head(2)
        for _, row in top_lose_y.iterrows():
            facts.append({"entity":row['Entity'],"metric":"revenue","period":"YoY",
                          "value":round(float(row['YoY_calc']),1),
                          "formula":"(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LY)/Revenue_LY*100"})

    # Cap at 25 facts
    facts = facts[:25]

    print(json.dumps(facts))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
